name: lsetxattr
synopsis: int lsetxattr(const char *path, const char *name, const void *value, size_t size, int flags);
description: lsetxattr sets the value of an extended attribute for a file or symbolic link specified by path. It operates directly on symbolic links without following them, unlike setxattr. The function allows specifying flags to control whether the attribute is created or replaced.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file, directory, or symbolic link.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the extended attribute, including a namespace prefix.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Pointer to the value data to set for the attribute.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size in bytes of the value data.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to modify behavior, such as XATTR_CREATE or XATTR_REPLACE.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Disk quota limits meant that there is insufficient space remaining to store the extended attribute.
XATTR_CREATE was specified, and the attribute exists already.
XATTR_REPLACE was specified, and the attribute does not exist.
There is insufficient space remaining to store the extended attribute.
The namespace prefix of name is not valid, or extended attributes are not supported by the filesystem.
The file is marked immutable or append-only.
The size of name or value exceeds a filesystem-specific limit.
